_comment: Draft entries for Sidera's data/data_sources.json (schema_version 1, layout read 2026-10-06). Hashes are those of the files archived in this repository's data/raw on 2026-10-06 (see plans/kanit outputs). Licence fields marked UNVERIFIED were not read from the provider's page in this project; Sidera's rule is to state, not invent.

datasets.name: gfz_kp_ap_sn_f107_daily
datasets.description: GFZ Potsdam daily geomagnetic Kp/ap/Ap, international sunspot number and observed/adjusted F10.7 since 1932 (40-line header, blank-separated).
datasets.license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0, except the sunspot-number column (CC BY-NC 4.0, WDC-SILSO), as stated in the file header.
datasets.source: GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences, Geomagnetic Observatory Niemegk
datasets.notes: Downloaded 2026-10-06. The file is updated continuously; the archived copy is frozen by its hash. Cite Matzka et al. 2021, doi:10.1029/2020SW002641.

datasets.name: set_jb2008_solfsmy
datasets.description: Space Environment Technologies daily F10, S10, M10, Y10 and 81-day centred means for JB2008 (release 8_1_0).
datasets.license_or_terms: UNVERIFIED: the SET terms page was not read (the index directory returns 403).

datasets.name: set_jb2008_dtcfile
datasets.description: Space Environment Technologies hourly dTc temperature correction for JB2008 (DTC YYYY DDD + 24 values, no header).
datasets.notes: Downloaded 2026-10-06. Unit (K) and hour mapping of the 24 values are not verified from a primary document. Hash to be computed from the archived copy on merge day.

datasets.name: silso_sunspot_monthly
datasets.description: WDC-SILSO monthly mean total sunspot number, version 2.0.
datasets.license_or_terms: CC BY-NC 4.0 per the GFZ header's statement about SILSO data; SILSO's own licence page not read (UNVERIFIED).
datasets.notes: Downloaded 2026-10-06 with SN_ms_tot_V2.0.txt (13-month smoothed) and Cycles/TableCyclesMiMa.txt.

datasets.name: richardson_cane_icme_list
datasets.description: Richardson and Cane near-Earth ICME list since 1996 (icmetable2.xlsx, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/C2MHTH).
datasets.license_or_terms: CC0 (Dataverse record, noted in an earlier session; re-check the record page on merge day).
datasets.source: I. G. Richardson and H. V. Cane, Harvard Dataverse
datasets.notes: 644 events (1996-05 to 2026-07) at download on 2026-10-06; md5 7fe7cb07... recorded in plans/05.

datasets.name: weimer2023_heating_deltat
datasets.description: Weimer et al. 2023 data archive: W05 hemispheric Poynting flux and delta-T at 4-minute cadence, 2000-2019 (Heating_DeltaT.h5).
datasets.license_or_terms: UNVERIFIED: the Zenodo record's licence field was not read.
datasets.source: Zenodo record 7667515 (Weimer, Mehta, Licata, Tobiska), doi:10.1029/2022SW003410
